cases.decision: The bounded retry change has medium ratings and reliable focused checks, so start one ordinary Terra/medium worker without an advisor loop. Root owns every durable write. W1 may receive one same-worker guided correction at unchanged settings. On Codex, send_message continues a running W1 and followup_task resumes an idle W1; either preserves the same context and does not increase the distinct-agent count. After the initial result and that correction both fail the permanent-error criterion, the diagnosed gap is insufficient reasoning in an otherwise sound approach. Because no effort increase has been used, stop and verify W1, then establish fresh W2 at Terra/high under the one permitted effort increase. Preserve both failures and do not call W2 a resume. An ambiguous spawn with no creation readback remains unresolved, cannot count as a confirmed agent, and blocks retry or ownership transfer until host state is reconciled. If the host rejects a user-required model or effort, the affected assignment is blocked; do not substitute. If a native profile resolves to settings that conflict with an explicit requirement, reject that profile for the assignment and keep the explicit requirement pending. Advisor consultations remain not applicable.
